children.notes: everyone = 每个人，作主语时谓语动词用单数。
children.statement: 这句话是一个简单的问候语。
children.explanation: Hello, everyone! 常用于演讲或自我介绍的开场白。

children.text: I am very glad to introduce myself to you.
children.cn: 我很高兴向大家作自我介绍。
children.explanation: glad 是表达喜悦常用形容词。

children.text: My name is Li Hua and I am 13 years old.
children.statement: 这句话介绍了名字和年龄。
children.explanation: 年龄表达用数字加 years old。

children.text: My favourite colour is blue because it looks like the sea.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色，因为它看起来像大海。
children.notes: favourite = 最喜欢的；colour = 颜色
children.statement: 这句话使用了 because 引导原因状语从句。
children.explanation: because 用于解释喜欢蓝色的原因。

children.text: I like reading books and playing basketball in my free time.
children.cn: 我在空闲时间喜欢读书和打篮球。
children.notes: in one's free time = 在某人的空闲时间
children.statement: like 后面可以接动词的 ing 形式。
children.explanation: like doing sth 表示习惯性爱好。

children.text: I hope we can be good friends.
children.cn: 我希望我们能成为好朋友。
children.statement: 这句话表达了交朋友的愿望。
children.explanation: 作为结尾句非常合适，呼应单元主题。

children.text: I also like playing basketball with my classmates after school.
children.cn: 放学后我还喜欢和同班同学一起打篮球。
children.notes: also: 也; after school: 放学后
children.statement: “play basketball” 中间不需要加冠词 the。
children.explanation: 球类运动前不加定冠词 the。
children.keywords: also, play basketball, classmates, after school

children.text: Hello, nice to meet you all! Today, I am more than happy to share something about myself.
children.cn: 大家好，很高兴认识你们！今天，我非常高兴能分享一些关于我自己的事情。
children.notes: more than happy = 非常高兴
children.statement: 这句话使用了 'more than happy' 增强语气。
children.explanation: more than 意为“极其、非常”，比单纯用 very 更生动。

children.text: My name is Li Hua, a 13-year-old boy who is always full of energy.
children.cn: 我叫李华，是一个总是充满活力的十三岁男孩。
children.notes: a 13-year-old boy 作同位语；who 引导定语从句
children.statement: 这句话使用了复合结构和定语从句修饰 boy。
children.explanation: 复合结构使句子更紧凑高级。

children.text: When it comes to my favourite colour, blue is definitely my top choice because it brings me peace.
children.cn: 说到我最喜欢的颜色，蓝色绝对是我的首选，因为它带给我平静。
children.notes: When it comes to = 当谈到...; definitely = 肯定地
children.statement: 句首使用了 'When it comes to' 作为高级连接短语。
children.explanation: When it comes to 是英语写作中引出话题的高频高级句型。
children.keywords: When it comes to, definitely, because

children.text: In addition, I have a wide range of hobbies, such as reading science fiction and playing basketball.
children.cn: 此外，我有广泛的爱好，比如读科幻小说和打篮球。
children.notes: In addition = 此外；such as = 例如
children.statement: 这句话使用了 'In addition' 和 'such as' 使文章更有逻辑性。
children.explanation: 衔接词和举例短语的使用提升了文章的连贯性。

children.text: If you share similar interests, please feel free to talk to me so that we can make friends.
children.cn: 如果你有相似的兴趣，请随时跟我交流，以便我们可以交朋友。
children.notes: If = 如果；so that = 以便
children.statement: 这句话使用了条件状语从句和目的状语从句。
children.explanation: 多从句的运用展示了较高的句式掌控能力。
